channel.title: The Compounding Journal
channel.description: Practical money systems, intentional work, and the patient path toward financial freedom.

item.title: The Psychology of Money Decisions: Why Knowing the Maths Is Not Enough
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Nobody fails at money because they cannot calculate compound interest. They fail because the decision arrives in a moment, and the consequence arrives in a decade — and the mind is not built for that gap.

item.title: Passive Income Is Not One Thing: Four Engines and What Each One Costs
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: A dividend fund, a rented flat, a bond ladder and a product you sold once are four different machines. They differ in the capital they need, the hours they quietly demand, and how they break.

item.title: What a Century of Market History Teaches: Drawdowns, Recovery and Diversification
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Over the long run the market goes up — a true sentence, and almost useless. The numbers that decide whether you stay invested are how deep the falls went, how long they lasted, and what they did to a mixed portfolio.

item.title: Sequence-of-Returns Risk: Why the Order of Returns Decides Your Retirement
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: The same average return can leave one retiree comfortable and another broke. What decides it is the order the returns arrive in — and that is the one variable no average can show you.

item.title: Your Savings Rate, Not Your Salary, Sets the Date You Become Free
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Work through the arithmetic of financial independence and something strange happens: your income cancels out. What is left is the gap between what you earn and what you spend, and that gap sets a date.

item.title: Debt Management: How to Get Out and Stay Out of Debt
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Debt can feel overwhelming, but the right strategy can change everything. Compare Good vs. Bad Debt and learn the Snowball vs. Avalanche payoff methods.

item.title: Put Your Money to Work: Make Money While You Sleep
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Saving alone won't build wealth due to inflation. Discover how compound growth, stocks, real estate, and passive streams let your money work while you sleep.

item.title: Spending with Purpose: How to Align Your Money with What Truly Matters
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Financial growth isn't about cutting all joy—it's about intentional spending. Discover how aligning purchases with your core values unlocks lasting freedom.

item.title: Foundations of Personal Finance: How to Control Expenses and Build Wealth
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Discover simple tips for budgeting, tracking expenses, and making smarter money choices to achieve financial freedom without giving up what makes you happy.

item.title: Building Wealth Through Good Financial Habits: Key Lessons from Rich Dad, Poor Dad
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Discover how to build long-term wealth using proven financial habits from Rich Dad, Poor Dad. Learn the key differences between assets, liabilities, good debt, and cash flow.

item.title: Pay Yourself First: The Simple Habit to Build Lasting Wealth
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: Learn how saving a fixed percentage before spending can break the paycheck-to-paycheck cycle and help you easily build an emergency fund.

item.title: The slow money system: a calmer way to build wealth
item.dc:creator: Sandy Bradbury
item.description: A practical weekly rhythm that replaces financial urgency with a small set of repeatable decisions.
